stories.title: Brown Bear Population in Spain Doubles With Incredible Increase of its Breeding Range
stories.label: animals
stories.summary: Spain's Cantabrian brown bears were down to as few as 140 in the early 2000s, but thanks to two decades of protection efforts, their numbers have now doubled to about 370. Even better, the bears have expanded their territory to roam across 6,500 square miles of northern Spain. It's a real comeback story for a species that was once on the brink. Local conservation programs, habitat protection, and reduced hunting pressure all get credit for turning things around. It's a reminder that when we give wildlife room and time, nature can bounce back.
stories.why_good: A documented, measurable wildlife recovery from active conservation efforts, with no suffering or disaster at its core.

stories.title: For Centuries, Visitors Walked Right by 280 Unseen Ice Age Cave Paintings
stories.label: science
stories.summary: Researchers in Spain just found 280 Ice Age engravings that had been hiding in plain sight for centuries. Thousands of visitors had walked right past the cave walls without anyone noticing the ancient artwork carved into the stone. It's now considered the third-largest collection of its kind ever found on Spain's Mediterranean coast. A little closer looking turned up a huge piece of human history that had been there all along.
stories.why_good: A real, confirmed archaeological discovery that expands our understanding of ancient human creativity, with no downside or tragedy attached.
